mods.name: pv big houses 2x2 farms flying carts upd1
mods.summary: 2x2 Farms and Rice Farms with matching placement previews. 20% faster farming, +50 population per House, flying Trade Carts, passable Markets, and walls for every civilization. Rebuilt on current game data (build 188329). Unit corpses fade after 30 seconds instead of 5 minutes, which removes up to a quarter of the objects in late games. Select as the Data Mod before starting a new custom game.

mods.name: pv 2x2 farms military builds
mods.summary:
2x2 Farms and Rice Farms, with matching 2x2 placement previews and dead-farm remnants. Farming is 20% faster and each farm holds 20% more food (210 instead of 175; Horse Collar, Heavy Plow and Crop Rotation still add their usual amounts). Each House gives 50 population. Flying Trade Carts. Passable Markets. Military buildings (Barracks, Archery Range, Stable, Siege Workshop, Castle, Krepost) use the non-blocking settings of FTC Military Builds. Stone and Fortified Walls for every civilization. Unit and wild-animal corpses fade after 30 seconds instead of 5 minutes.

Based on pv big houses 2x2 farms flying carts upd1. Flying cart and military building settings follow GJ Euphory's "FTC v2.0 - H - NW - Military Builds". Built on game build 188329 data.

Select as the Data Mod before starting a new custom game. In multiplayer, every player must use the same data mod version.

mods.name: Cheap Walls  Feitoria 10 Pop - 2x2 Farms pv
mods.summary: 2x2 Farms and Rice Farms with matching placement previews. 20% faster farming, +50 population per House, flying Trade Carts, passable Markets, and walls for every civilization. Cheap walls: every wall section and every gate (palisade, stone, fortified and sea gates) costs nothing. Feitoria takes 10 population instead of 20. Rebuilt on current game data (build 188329). Unit corpses fade after 30 seconds instead of 5 minutes, which removes up to a quarter of the objects in late games. Select as the Data Mod before starting a new custom game.

mods.name: pv 2x wood Portuguese military builds
mods.summary:
Portuguese changes: the Feitoria takes 5 population instead of 20 (cost unchanged). Portuguese can research Paladin at the Stable. Portuguese Castles also train the Conquistador (75 food, 60 gold; Castle Age, button next to Petard), with the Elite Conquistador upgrade at the Castle.

Every tree holds twice the wood (forest trees 200 instead of 100), and lumberjacks chop twice as fast and carry twice as much, so each tree takes the same time to cut down while giving double the wood. Wood upgrades (Double-Bit Axe, Bow Saw, Two-Man Saw, Wheelbarrow, Hand Cart) and civilization bonuses keep working on top.

Also includes everything from pv 2x wood 2x2 farms military builds and pv 2x2 farms military builds: 2x2 Farms and Rice Farms, with matching 2x2 placement previews and dead-farm remnants.
